description.en: Yoru is an ad-light anime streaming site. Show the anime and episode you are watching, the audio track you picked, and how far into the episode you are.

settings.title: Privacy Mode
settings.description: Hide anime titles, episodes and search terms, and show only that you are on Yoru.

settings.title: Show Cover Art
settings.description: Use the cover of the anime you are watching as the large image instead of the Yoru logo.

settings.title: Show Timestamps
settings.description: Show how much time is left in the episode you are watching.

settings.title: Show Buttons
settings.description: Show buttons linking to the episode and the anime you are watching.
